sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that if the allegations as levelled in the FIR and in the charge-sheet are taken on its face value or in its entirety even no offence under Sections 467, 468 and 420 of IPC is made out as the ingredients essential to constitute the offence are blatantly and conspicuously missing.
2.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has also placed reliance upon the judgment passed by Hon'ble the Supreme Court in the case of Mohd. Ibrahim & Ors. Vs. State of Bihar & Anr. reported in (2009)
8 SCC 751.
3.

4. Issue notice, returnable within a period of six weeks.
